# Eolent

> Open-source modular application framework for line-of-business and multi-tenant SaaS applications. This repository holds the language-neutral specification, the architecture decision records and the documentation.

## Contract

- [Specification overview](spec/README.md): contents, versioning and changelog of the specification
- [Module manifest schema](spec/module.schema.json): JSON Schema for the module manifest
- [API conventions](spec/api-conventions.md): the OpenAPI profile
- [Error format](spec/error-format.md): RFC 9457 problem details and error codes
- [Tenancy](spec/tenancy.md): tenants, tenant resolution and isolation
- [Permissions](spec/permissions.md): permissions, features and the access endpoint
- [Audit log](spec/audit.md): audit entries and agent-for-user fields
- [Events](spec/events.md): the event envelope, a CloudEvents profile
- [Localization](spec/localization.md): message files, culture fallback and llms.txt

## Docs

- [Vision](docs/vision.md): what Eolent is and why
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): layers, modules and technology choices
- [AI friendliness](docs/ai-friendliness.md): how agents build with and use Eolent
- [Architecture decision records](docs/adr/0001-repository-structure.md): decisions and their reasons

## Optional

- [Roadmap](docs/roadmap.md): planned phases
- [Release checklist](docs/release-checklist.md): the gates for a release, including the licence re-check
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute and the DCO sign-off
